name: Ujjayi Breathing (Ocean's Breath)
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably with a tall spine, and take a few natural breaths through your nose.
Slightly constrict the back of your throat, as if quietly fogging up a mirror, but keep your mouth closed.
Inhale through your nose, letting the breath make a soft, steady ocean-like sound in your throat.
Exhale through your nose with the same gentle constriction, keeping the sound smooth and even.
Continue for 5-10 minutes, keeping the sound consistent without straining your throat.
